Hardened Zephyr Rule 3 compression only: exact zero TC/flow match, fe80::/64 endpoints (including multicast rejection), ICMPv6 checksum validation before selection, zero DIO flags/reserved match, deterministic 312-bit/39-byte MSB-first residue, opaque option-tail preservation, atomic output preflight, and 22554-byte encoded profile ceiling. Corrupt/nonmatching packets preserve parity via Rule 255. Added focused standalone C canonical-vector, field-extreme, opaque-tail, nonmatch, checksum, short-buffer, and exact/over-profile tests.
